    wd = ImageDraw.Draw(wash)
    for i in range(8):
        x = int(rng.integers(-200, w + 200))
        y = int(rng.integers(-100, h + 100))
        rx = int(rng.integers(180, 420))
        ry = int(rng.integers(50, 120))
        wd.ellipse((x - rx, y - ry, x + rx, y + ry), fill=(20, 2, 3, 12))
    im = Image.alpha_composite(im, wash)
    vig = Image.new("L", (w, h), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(vig).ellipse((-w * 0.15, -h * 0.15, w * 1.15, h * 1.15), fill=255)
    vig = vig.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(max(w, h) * 0.08))
    dark = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    dark.putalpha(Image.eval(vig, lambda v: int((255 - v) * 0.30)))
    return Image.alpha_composite(im, dark)


def shield_cutout():
    src = os.path.join(HERE, "reference.jpg")
    shutil.copyfile(REF, src)
    im = Image.open(src).convert("RGB").crop((580, 300, 1520, 1360))
    flood = im.copy()
    for xy in [(0, 0), (im.width - 1, 0), (0, im.height - 1), (im.width - 1, im.height - 1)]:
        ImageDraw.floodfill(flood, xy, (255, 0, 255), thresh=12)
    fa = np.asarray(flood)
    outside = (fa[:, :, 0] == 255) & (fa[:, :, 1] == 0) & (fa[:, :, 2] == 255)
    alpha = np.where(outside, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
    alpha = np.asarray(Image.fromarray(alpha, "L").filter(ImageFilter.MinFilter(5))).copy()
    rgba = np.dstack([np.asarray(im), alpha]).astype(np.uint8)
    logo = Image.fromarray(rgba, "RGBA")
    return logo.crop(logo.getbbox())


def text_layer(target_h=210, max_width=900):
    scale = 2
    target = target_h * scale
    gap = 18 * scale
    font = ImageFont.truetype(r"C:\Windows\Fonts\STXINGKA.TTF", 420)
    glyphs = []
    for ch in "兵哥烧烤":
        tmp = Image.new("RGBA", (700, 700), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        ImageDraw.Draw(tmp).text((70, 50), ch, font=font, fill=WHITE + (255,),
                                 stroke_width=4, stroke_fill=WHITE + (255,))
        bb = tmp.getbbox()
        g = tmp.crop(bb)
        w = max(1, int(round(g.width * target / g.height)))
        glyphs.append(g.resize((w, target), Image.LANCZOS))
    total = sum(g.width for g in glyphs) + gap * (len(glyphs) - 1)
    layer = Image.new("RGBA", (total, target), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    x = 0
    for g in glyphs:
        layer.alpha_composite(g, (x, target - g.height))
        x += g.width + gap
    layer = layer.resize((max(1, layer.width // scale), max(1, layer.height // scale)), Image.LANCZOS)
    if layer.width > max_width:
        layer = layer.resize((max_width, layer.height), Image.LANCZOS)
    return layer


def add_shadow(bg, img, pos, color=(0, 0, 0), alpha=140, blur=16, offset=(0, 10)):
    shadow = Image.new("RGBA", bg.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
    a = img.getchannel("A").filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(blur))
    shadow.paste(color + (alpha,), (pos[0] + offset[0], pos[1] + offset[1]), a)
    bg.alpha_composite(shadow)


def full_square(size=1024, shield_h=630, text_top=700, text_h=210):
    bg = make_bg(size, size)
    shield = shield_cutout()
    sh = shield_h
    sw = int(shield.width * sh / shield.height)
    shield = shield.resize((sw, sh), Image.LANCZOS)
    sx, sy = (size - sw) // 2, 30
    add_shadow(bg, shield, (sx, sy), alpha=135, blur=18, offset=(0, 12))
    txt = text_layer(text_h, 900)
    tx, ty = (size - txt.width) // 2, text_top
    add_shadow(bg, txt, (tx, ty), alpha=170, blur=8, offset=(0, 7))
    bg.alpha_composite(shield, (sx, sy))
    bg.alpha_composite(txt, (tx, ty))
    return bg


def avatar(size=1024):
    bg = make_bg(size, size)
    shield = shield_cutout()
    h = int(size * 0.84)
    w = int(shield.width * h / shield.height)
    shield = shield.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)
    x, y = (size - w) // 2, (size - h) // 2 + int(size * 0.01)
    add_shadow(bg, shield, (x, y), alpha=140, blur=20, offset=(0, 14))
    bg.alpha_composite(shield, (x, y))
    return bg


def banner(w=1200, h=600):
    bg = make_bg(w, h)
    if w <= 1200:
        shield_h, shield_cx = 430, 260
        divider_x, text_x, text_h = 470, 520, 150
        eng_y, tag_y, eng_size, tag_size = 410, 448, 22, 20
    else:
        shield_h, shield_cx = 470, 460
        divider_x, text_x, text_h = 690, 740, 165
        eng_y, tag_y, eng_size, tag_size = 425, 465, 24, 22
    shield = shield_cutout()
    sw = int(shield.width * shield_h / shield.height)
    shield = shield.resize((sw, shield_h), Image.LANCZOS)
    sx, sy = shield_cx - sw // 2, h // 2 - shield_h // 2
    add_shadow(bg, shield, (sx, sy), alpha=135, blur=18, offset=(0, 12))

    txt = text_layer(text_h, 650 if w <= 1200 else 720)
    tx = text_x
    ty = 218 if w <= 1200 else 215
    add_shadow(bg, txt, (tx, ty), alpha=170, blur=8, offset=(0, 7))

    bg.alpha_composite(shield, (sx, sy))
    bg.alpha_composite(txt, (tx, ty))

    d = ImageDraw.Draw(bg)
    d.line((divider_x, 150, divider_x, 450), fill=(255, 255, 255, 45), width=2)
    f_eng = ImageFont.truetype(r"C:\Windows\Fonts\NotoSansSC-VF.ttf", eng_size)
    f_tag = ImageFont.truetype(r"C:\Windows\Fonts\NotoSansSC-VF.ttf", tag_size)
    # letter-spaced English
    s = "BINGGE BBQ · FIELD GRILL"
    x = tx + 4
    for ch in s:
        d.text((x, eng_y), ch, font=f_eng, fill=(255, 255, 255, 190))
        x += f_eng.getlength(ch) + 4
    d.text((tx + 4, tag_y), "野营炭烤 · 现串现烤", font=f_tag, fill=(255, 255, 255, 150))
    return bg


def sticker(size=1024):
    r = int(size * 0.468)
    cx = cy = size // 2
    bg = make_bg(size, size)
    mask = Image.new("L", (size, size), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(mask).ellipse((cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r), fill=255)
    sticker_bg = Image.new("RGBA", (size, size), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    sticker_bg.paste(bg, (0, 0), mask)
    ring = Image.new("RGBA", (size, size), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    ImageDraw.Draw(ring).ellipse((cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r), outline=CREAM + (255,), width=max(4, size // 150))
    sticker_bg.alpha_composite(ring)

    shield = shield_cutout()
    sh = int(size * 0.46)
    sw = int(shield.width * sh / shield.height)
    shield = shield.resize((sw, sh), Image.LANCZOS)
    sx, sy = cx - sw // 2, int(size * 0.19)
    add_shadow(sticker_bg, shield, (sx, sy), alpha=120, blur=14, offset=(0, 8))

    txt = text_layer(int(size * 0.145), int(size * 0.62))
    tx, ty = cx - txt.width // 2, int(size * 0.68)
    add_shadow(sticker_bg, txt, (tx, ty), alpha=150, blur=7, offset=(0, 5))
    sticker_bg.alpha_composite(shield, (sx, sy))
    sticker_bg.alpha_composite(txt, (tx, ty))
    return sticker_bg


if __name__ == "__main__":
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    # quick checks
    full_square().save(os.path.join(OUT, "check-square.png"))
    avatar().save(os.path.join(OUT, "check-avatar.png"))
    banner().save(os.path.join(OUT, "check-banner.png"))
    sticker().save(os.path.join(OUT, "check-sticker.png"))
    print("checks written")
"}

{"file_path": "bingge-bbq\work-deliverables\build_guide.py", "content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Build a four-page brand guidelines PDF and page previews."""
import os
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import final_lib as L

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = L.ROOT
ASSETS = os.path.join(ROOT, "final-assets")
OUT = os.path.join(ASSETS, "05-brand-guidelines")
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

W, H = 1600, 2200
CREAM = (243, 231, 205)
PAPER = (239, 229, 210)
INK = (43, 49, 26)
RED = (122, 22, 26)
DARK = (45, 7, 9)
OLIVE = (107, 112, 53)
BROWN = (74, 31, 20)
ORANGE = (242, 138, 46)
BRASS = (176, 141, 79)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)

SERIF = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\NotoSerifSC-VF.ttf"
SANS = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\NotoSansSC-VF.ttf"
SANS_B = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\Noto Sans SC Bold (TrueType).otf"
XING = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\STXINGKA.TTF"

STORE = os.path.join(ASSETS, "02-store-logo", "bingge-store-logo-1024.png")
AVATAR = os.path.join(ASSETS, "01-avatar", "bingge-avatar-1024.png")
BANNER = os.path.join(ASSETS, "03-banner", "bingge-banner-1200x600.png")
STICKER = os.path.join(ASSETS, "04-sticker", "bingge-sticker-round-1024.png")


def font(path, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)


def text(d, xy, s, f, fill, anchor="la", spacing=0):
    # Pillow has no letter-spacing; draw per-char when needed
    if not spacing:
        d.text(xy, s, font=f, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)
        return
    x, y = xy
    for ch in s:
        d.text((x, y), ch, font=f, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)
        x += f.getlength(ch) + spacing


def rounded(img, box, radius=18, border=True, shadow=False):
    x, y, w, h = box
    img = img.convert("RGBA").resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)
    mask = Image.new("L", (w, h), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(mask).rounded_rectangle((0, 0, w, h), radius=radius, fill=255)
    if shadow:
        sh = Image.new("RGBA", (w + 40, h + 40), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        a = mask.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(18))
        sh.paste((0, 0, 0, 110), (20, 26), a)
        return img, mask, sh
    return img, mask


def paste_rounded(board, img, box, radius=18, border=True, shadow=False):
    x, y, w, h = box
    img = img.convert("RGBA").resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)
    mask = Image.new("L", (w, h), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(mask).rounded_rectangle((0, 0, w, h), radius=radius, fill=255)
    if shadow:
        sh = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        sh.paste((0, 0, 0, 90), (0, 12), mask.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(14)))
        board.alpha_composite(sh, (x, y))
    board.alpha_composite(img, (x, y), mask)
    if border:
        d = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
        d.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + w, y + h), radius=radius, outline=(43, 49, 26), width=1)


def paste_alpha(board, img, box, shadow=True):
    x, y, w, h = box
    img = img.convert("RGBA").resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)
    if shadow:
        sh = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        a = img.getchannel("A").filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(16))
        sh.paste((0, 0, 0, 95), (0, 10), a)
        board.alpha_composite(sh, (x, y))
    board.alpha_composite(img, (x, y))


def header(board, d, section, title, page):
    text(d, (100, 90), "BINGGE BBQ / VISUAL IDENTITY", font(SANS_B, 16), BRASS, spacing=3)
    text(d, (100, 145), title, font(SERIF, 64), INK)
    text(d, (1500, 100), f"{page:02d} / 04", font(SANS_B, 16), INK, anchor="ra", spacing=2)
    d.line((100, 245, 1500, 245), fill=INK, width=2)
    if section:
        text(d, (100, 265), section, font(SANS_B, 18), BRASS, spacing=2)


def footer(d, page):
    d.line((100, 2110, 1500, 2110), fill=INK, width=1)
    text(d, (100, 2130), "兵哥烧烤 · 品牌视觉规范 · 2026", font(SANS, 15), INK)
    text(d, (1500, 2130), f"{page:02d} / 04", font(SANS, 15), INK, anchor="ra")


def page1():
    bg = L.make_bg(W, H)

{"file_path": "bingge-bbq\work-deliverables\build_guide.py", "content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Build a four-page brand guidelines PDF and page previews."""
import os
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import final_lib as L

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = L.ROOT
ASSETS = os.path.join(ROOT, "final-assets")
OUT = os.path.join(ASSETS, "05-brand-guidelines")
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

W, H = 1600, 2200
CREAM = (243, 231, 205)
PAPER = (239, 229, 210)
INK = (43, 49, 26)
RED = (122, 22, 26)
DARK = (45, 7, 9)
OLIVE = (107, 112, 53)
BROWN = (74, 31, 20)
ORANGE = (242, 138, 46)
BRASS = (176, 141, 79)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)

SERIF = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\NotoSerifSC-VF.ttf"
SANS = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\NotoSansSC-VF.ttf"
SANS_B = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\Noto Sans SC Bold (TrueType).otf"
XING = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\STXINGKA.TTF"

STORE = os.path.join(ASSETS, "02-store-logo", "bingge-store-logo-1024.png")
AVATAR = os.path.join(ASSETS, "01-avatar", "bingge-avatar-1024.png")
BANNER = os.path.join(ASSETS, "03-banner", "bingge-banner-1200x600.png")
STICKER = os.path.join(ASSETS, "04-sticker", "bingge-sticker-round-1024.png")


def font(path, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)


def text(d, xy, s, f, fill, anchor="la", spacing=0):
    # Pillow has no letter-spacing; draw per-char when needed
    if not spacing:
        d.text(xy, s, font=f, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)
        return
    x, y = xy
    for ch in s:
        d.text((x, y), ch, font=f, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)
        x += f.getlength(ch) + spacing


def rounded(img, box, radius=18, border=True, shadow=False):
    x, y, w, h = box
    img = img.convert("RGBA").resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)
    mask = Image.new("L", (w, h), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(mask).rounded_rectangle((0, 0, w, h), radius=radius, fill=255)
    if shadow:
        sh = Image.new("RGBA", (w + 40, h + 40), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        a = mask.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(18))
        sh.paste((0, 0, 0, 110), (20, 26), a)
        return img, mask, sh
    return img, mask


def paste_rounded(board, img, box, radius=18, border=True, shadow=False):
    x, y, w, h = box
    img = img.convert("RGBA").resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)
    mask = Image.new("L", (w, h), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(mask).rounded_rectangle((0, 0, w, h), radius=radius, fill=255)
    if shadow:
        sh = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        sh.paste((0, 0, 0, 90), (0, 12), mask.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(14)))
        board.alpha_composite(sh, (x, y))
    board.alpha_composite(img, (x, y), mask)
    if border:
        d = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
        d.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + w, y + h), radius=radius, outline=(43, 49, 26), width=1)


def paste_alpha(board, img, box, shadow=True):
    x, y, w, h = box
    img = img.convert("RGBA").resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)
    if shadow:
        sh = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        a = img.getchannel("A").filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(16))

    for i, (label, val) in enumerate([("头像 80 px", "80"), ("方版 256 px", "256"), ("横版 1200 px", "1200")]):
        y = 1010 + i * 70
        text(d, (100, y), f"{label}", font(SANS, 19), INK)
        text(d, (420, y), val, font(SANS_B, 20), BRASS, anchor="ra")

    # platform use
    text(d, (700, 950), "平台使用", font(SANS_B, 26), INK)
    rows = [
        ("店铺头像 / 列表小图", "avatar 512 / 256"),
        ("店铺 Logo / 主视觉", "store-logo 800 / 1024"),
        ("店铺头图 / 横幅", "banner 1200 × 600"),
        ("包装贴纸 / 封口贴", "sticker 1024 / 512"),
    ]
    for i, (a, b) in enumerate(rows):
        y = 1015 + i * 55
        text(d, (700, y), a, font(SANS, 18), INK)
        text(d, (1440, y), b, font(SANS_B, 16), BRASS, anchor="ra")

    # do / don't
    d.line((100, 1320, 1500, 1320), fill=INK, width=1)
    text(d, (100, 1360), "DO", font(SANS_B, 22), OLIVE)
    text(d, (100, 1405), "深红底 + 白字 + 盾牌原内容；主标识和头像分开使用。", font(SANS, 18), INK)
    text(d, (100, 1445), "需要白边时，只给字加白边，不要把星星再加奶油边。", font(SANS, 18), INK)
    text(d, (820, 1360), "DON'T", font(SANS_B, 22), RED)
    text(d, (820, 1405), "不要拉伸、改色、加投影或换盾牌比例。", font(SANS, 18), INK)
    text(d, (820, 1445), "不要把字标拆成单字或改成其他字体组合。", font(SANS, 18), INK)

    # license
    d.rounded_rectangle((100, 1560, 1500, 1740), radius=16, fill=(230, 216, 190, 255))
    text(d, (130, 1600), "字体授权提醒", font(SANS_B, 22), INK)
    text(d, (130, 1645), "华文行楷为系统字体，当前用于视觉稿。正式商用前请确认字库授权范围（Logo / 商标 / 门店数量）。", font(SANS, 17), INK)
    text(d, (130, 1680), "如未取得授权，可替换为马善政毛笔楷书（OFL）或购买对应字库。", font(SANS, 17), INK)

    footer(d, 4)
    return bg.convert("RGB")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    pages = [page1(), page2(), page3(), page4()]
    for i, p in enumerate(pages, 1):
        p.save(os.path.join(OUT, f"brand-page-{i}.png"))
    pages[0].save(os.path.join(OUT, "brand-cover.png"))
    pages[0].save(os.path.join(OUT, "bingge-brand-guidelines.pdf"), save_all=True, append_images=pages[1:], resolution=150.0)
    print("saved", OUT)
"}

{"file_path": "bingge-bbq\final-assets\README.txt", "content": "兵哥烧烤 / BINGGE BBQ
外卖平台视觉交付 · 2026

最终视觉
- 背景：暗红 #7A161A（深酒红，边缘 #2D0709）
- 字标：华文行楷，纯白 #FFFFFF，四个字等高
- 盾牌：原图内容不改，五角星无奶油色描边
- 字体授权：华文行楷为系统字体，正式商用前请确认字库授权范围（Logo / 商标 / 门店数量）；如未授权，可改用马善政毛笔楷书（OFL）或购买对应字库。

文件夹说明
01-avatar
  店铺头像 / 列表小图，无文字盾牌。
  1024 / 512 / 256 / 160 / 80 px，PNG + 1024 JPG。
  外卖平台优先上传 512；80 px 用于最小尺寸测试。

02-store-logo
  店铺 Logo / 主视觉，盾牌 + 完整字标。
  1024 / 800 / 512 / 256 px，PNG + 1024 JPG。
  外卖平台优先上传 800 或 1024。

03-banner
  店铺头图 / 横幅。
  1200 × 600（主用）和 1600 × 600（宽幅），PNG + 1200 JPG。
  头图核心内容在中间安全区，平台自动裁切时保留中间 80% 高度。

04-sticker
  包装贴纸 / 封口贴。
  bingge-sticker-round: 深红圆章 + 完整字标，透明底，1024 / 512。
  bingge-sticker-shield: 无字盾牌透明底，1024 / 512，适合异形模切。

tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

content.text:
We have a new image: a food photo of stir-fried snails (炒螺) with a white plate, light background, a watermark/overlaid text at bottom "嗦螺爱好者快试吧" maybe in white. User says "画面扩充一下，背景改暗一点" = "Expand the image/canvas a bit, make the background darker."

We need interpret: They want edit this food photo: expand the frame (outpaint/uncrop) and darken the background. This is a new task, unrelated to logo. Need produce edited image. We don't have generative AI image editing tools, but can do with Pillow: background darkening, canvas extension via blurred/mirrored edges or generative fill? "画面扩充一下" likely means make the composition wider / add canvas around the dish, perhaps for a banner. "背景改暗一点" darken the background (the light wall/table) while keeping the food plate lit.

We need know intended use: likely a food image for the BBQ brand? They may want a wider image with darker background for menu/banner. The image is 2670x1200 (wide). The dish fills most of frame, white plate edges at left/right. "画面扩充" could mean outpainting to make it wider or taller, maybe 1:1? They didn't specify aspect ratio. Could mean "expand the scene a bit" (add margin around the plate) then darken background. Need ask? We can infer make a **wider canvas** with more dark background around the dish, perhaps 16:9 or 3:2. The current 2670x1200 is ~2.225:1, already wide. "画面扩充一下" might mean zoom out/add space around the dish so it doesn't feel cramped, and darken the background.

We can do a high-quality edit with Pillow:
- Crop out the overlaid text at bottom? The text is part of the image, maybe a caption/watermark. The user didn't ask to remove it, but it's distracting. "画面扩充" maybe they want to use it as a background; the text at bottom might need removal. We can remove it by cropping bottom or inpainting. 
- Darken background: create a mask for the background (light wall/table) and apply a darkening/tint, while preserving the plate/food. The background is light beige; we can selectively darken pixels outside the plate. The plate is white, food dark. A simple luminance mask won't distinguish plate from background (both light). We need a plate/food mask.
- Use image segmentation? No cv2/scipy, but we can use manual polygon/ellipse masks around the plate/food. The plate is roughly centered, with white edges at left/right. We can create a **soft elliptical/rounded rectangle mask** covering the dish and plate, and darken outside. The background then becomes darker, with a smooth transition; the plate edges remain bright inside the mask. This is feasible.
- "画面扩充": We can create a new canvas (e.g., 3000x1600 or 3200x1800) with a dark background gradient, place the original image (or cropped dish) in the center, and add extra dark background around it. But the original image's background is light; if we place it as a rectangle, the edges show. We need extend the background seamlessly:
  - Use **edge stretch/mirror blur**: take strips from the image edges, blur heavily, stretch into the new margins, and darken. This creates a soft out-of-focus extension, which looks natural for a food photo. The plate might get cut at the edges; the original plate is within frame, so adding margins around is okay.
  - Or use **reflection padding** of the background with blur. 
  - Create a new canvas with dark background; place the original image centered with a soft **vignette/feather** at the edges? The original image edges (light wall/table) would transition to dark canvas; could look like a spotlight. 
  - Better: extend the image by **mirroring/blurring edge strips** and darkening the whole background. The dish stays center; more dark space around it.
- The original aspect 2670x1200. If we expand to 3200x1600, add 265px left/right and 200px top/bottom. The plate is centered; more breathing room. The background wall/table at edges extends via mirrored/blurred strips. 
- Darken background: apply a **radial gradient darkening** outside the dish/plate, plus overall exposure reduction in background. The light wall becomes dark brown/charcoal, matching food photography. The plate stays bright; food colors pop.
- Remove the bottom overlay text "嗦螺爱好者快试吧" (watermark) because it would be in the expanded image and look bad. The user didn't ask, but it's likely a watermark/caption. We can crop it out or inpaint. The text is at the bottom over the plate/sauce; removing it requires content-aware fill. We could crop the bottom 40px, but it cuts the plate. Or use a dark gradient at the bottom to hide it; but text is white, a dark overlay can obscure. The text is at the very bottom, spanning the plate. If we expand the canvas and add a dark **bottom band**, the text could be covered with a gradient, but it would also darken the plate edge. Alternatively, clone nearby sauce/plate texture over the text. 
  - The text is at y~1120-1190, on the plate/sauce. We can sample nearby pixels and patch, but complex.

{"file_path": "bingge-bbq\work-food\expand.py", "content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Expand the food photo to 16:9, blur/darken the surrounding background."""
import os
import shutil
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter, ImageEnhance

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "food")
REF = r"C:\Users\24380\.dsh\attachments\v1\objects\f8\f88b81de81202c08403702f807dde19cf6f778efc0eb431a5f50bed9aa72761c"

W, H = 3200, 1800


def load():
    shutil.copyfile(REF, os.path.join(HERE, "source.jpg"))
    im = Image.open(os.path.join(HERE, "source.jpg")).convert("RGB")
    # remove the bottom white caption
    im = im.crop((0, 0, im.width, im.height - 100))
    return im


def grade(im):
    im = ImageEnhance.Color(im).enhance(1.10)
    im = ImageEnhance.Contrast(im).enhance(1.06)
    # warm grade
    r, g, b = im.split()
    r = r.point(lambda v: min(255, int(v * 1.035)))
    b = b.point(lambda v: int(v * 0.965))
    im = Image.merge("RGB", (r, g, b))
    return im


def background(im):
    # cover-fill and blur heavily
    ratio = max(W / im.width, H / im.height)
    bw, bh = int(im.width * ratio), int(im.height * ratio)
    bg = im.resize((bw, bh), Image.LANCZOS)
    bg = bg.crop(((bw - W) // 2, (bh - H) // 2, (bw - W) // 2 + W, (bh - H) // 2 + H))
    bg = bg.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(55))
    bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(bg).enhance(0.46)
    bg = ImageEnhance.Color(bg).enhance(0.85)
    # warm dark brown overlay
    overlay = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (24, 8, 6))
    bg = Image.blend(bg, overlay, 0.28)
    return bg


def rim_darken(im):
    """Darken the background around the dish, protect the centre."""
    w, h = im.size
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:h, 0:w].astype(np.float32)
    cx, cy = w * 0.50, h * 0.55
    d = np.sqrt(((xx - cx) / (w * 0.62)) ** 2 + ((yy - cy) / (h * 0.62)) ** 2)
    d = np.clip((d - 0.35) / 0.75, 0, 1)
    mult = 1.0 - 0.55 * (d ** 1.4)
    arr = np.asarray(im).astype(np.float32)
    arr *= mult[:, :, None]
    return Image.fromarray(np.clip(arr, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8), "RGB")


def feather_mask(size, feather=120):
    w, h = size
    m = Image.new("L", (w, h), 255)
    # erode with a blurred rectangle to soften edges
    inner = Image.new("L", (w, h), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(inner).rectangle((feather, feather, w - feather, h - feather), fill=255)
    inner = inner.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(feather * 0.55))
    # combine: keep full centre, fade to 0 at the outer 1 px
    mask = Image.new("L", (w, h), 0)
    mask.paste(inner, (0, 0))
    # ensure alpha 0 at the exact border
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
    d.rectangle((0, 0, w, 2), fill=0)
    d.rectangle((0, h - 2, w, h), fill=0)
    d.rectangle((0, 0, 2, h), fill=0)
    d.rectangle((w - 2, 0, w, h), fill=0)
    return mask


def main():
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    im = load()
    im = grade(im)
    im = rim_darken(im)

    bg = background(im)

    # sharp photo sits inside with breathing room
    target_w = 2800
    target_h = int(im.height * target_w / im.width)
    sharp = im.resize((target_w, target_h), Image.LANCZOS)
    x = (W - target_w) // 2
    y = (H - target_h) // 2
    mask = feather_mask((target_w, target_h), 140)
    bg.paste(sharp, (x, y), mask)

    # final vignette / focus
    vig = Image.new("L", (W, H), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(vig).ellipse((-W * 0.15, -H * 0.20, W * 1.15, H * 1.20), fill=255)
    vig = vig.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(220))
    dark = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (10, 4, 3))
    bg = Image.composite(bg, dark, vig)

    bg.save(os.path.join(OUT, "food-expanded-3200x1800.png"))
    bg.convert("RGB").save(os.path.join(OUT, "food-expanded-3200x1800.jpg"), "JPEG", quality=94, subsampling=0, optimize=True)
    bg.resize((1920, 1080), Image.LANCZOS).save(os.path.join(OUT, "food-expanded-1920x1080.png"))
    print("saved", bg.size)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Expand the food photo to 16:9, blur/darken the surrounding background."""
import os
import shutil
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter, ImageEnhance

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "food")

    im = Image.open(os.path.join(HERE, "source.jpg")).convert("RGB")
    # remove the bottom white caption
    im = im.crop((0, 0, im.width, im.height - 100))
    return im


def grade(im):
    im = ImageEnhance.Color(im).enhance(1.10)
    im = ImageEnhance.Contrast(im).enhance(1.06)
    # warm grade
    r, g, b = im.split()
    r = r.point(lambda v: min(255, int(v * 1.035)))
    b = b.point(lambda v: int(v * 0.965))
    im = Image.merge("RGB", (r, g, b))
    return im


def background(im):
    # cover-fill and blur heavily
    ratio = max(W / im.width, H / im.height)
    bw, bh = int(im.width * ratio), int(im.height * ratio)
    bg = im.resize((bw, bh), Image.LANCZOS)
    bg = bg.crop(((bw - W) // 2, (bh - H) // 2, (bw - W) // 2 + W, (bh - H) // 2 + H))
    bg = bg.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(55))
    bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(bg).enhance(0.46)
    bg = ImageEnhance.Color(bg).enhance(0.85)
    # warm dark brown overlay
    overlay = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (24, 8, 6))
    bg = Image.blend(bg, overlay, 0.28)
    return bg


def rim_darken(im):
    """Darken the background around the dish, protect the centre."""
    w, h = im.size
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:h, 0:w].astype(np.float32)
    cx, cy = w * 0.50, h * 0.55
    d = np.sqrt(((xx - cx) / (w * 0.62)) ** 2 + ((yy - cy) / (h * 0.62)) ** 2)

    arr *= mult[:, :, None]
    return Image.fromarray(np.clip(arr, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8), "RGB")

    m = Image.new("L", (w, h), 255)
    # erode with a blurred rectangle to soften edges
    inner = Image.new("L", (w, h), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(inner).rectangle((feather, feather, w - feather, h - feather), fill=255)
    inner = inner.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(feather * 0.55))
    # combine: keep full centre, fade to 0 at the outer 1 px
    mask = Image.new("L", (w, h), 0)
    mask.paste(inner, (0, 0))
    # ensure alpha 0 at the exact border
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
    d.rectangle((0, 0, w, 2), fill=0)
    d.rectangle((0, h - 2, w, h), fill=0)
    d.rectangle((0, 0, 2, h), fill=0)
    d.rectangle((w - 2, 0, w, h), fill=0)
    return mask


def main():
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    im = load()
    im = grade(im)
    im = rim_darken(im)

    bg = background(im)

    # sharp photo sits inside with breathing room
    target_w = 2800
    target_h = int(im.height * target_w / im.width)
    sharp = im.resize((target_w, target_h), Image.LANCZOS)
    x = (W - target_w) // 2
    y = (H - target_h) // 2
    mask = feather_mask((target_w, target_h), 140)
    bg.paste(sharp, (x, y), mask)

    # final vignette / focus
    vig = Image.new("L", (W, H), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(vig).ellipse((-W * 0.15, -H * 0.20, W * 1.15, H * 1.20), fill=255)
    vig = vig.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(220))
    dark = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (10, 4, 3))
    bg = Image.composite(bg, dark, vig)

    bg.save(os.path.join(OUT, "food-expanded-3200x1800.png"))
    bg.convert("RGB").save(os.path.join(OUT, "food-expanded-3200x1800.jpg"), "JPEG", quality=94, subsampling=0, optimize=True)
    bg.resize((1920, 1080), Image.LANCZOS).save(os.path.join(OUT, "food-expanded-1920x1080.png"))
    print("saved", bg.size)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"}

{"file_path": "bingge-bbq\work-food\expand_seamless.py", "content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Full-width 16:9 extension with vertical fade, no visible photo frame."""
import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
import expand as E

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "food")
W, H = 3200, 1800


def main():
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    im = E.load()
    im = E.grade(im)
    im = E.rim_darken(im)

    bg = E.background(im)

    target_w = W
    target_h = int(im.height * target_w / im.width)
    sharp = im.resize((target_w, target_h), Image.LANCZOS)
    y0 = (H - target_h) // 2

    # vertical alpha fade only; left/right are full-bleed
    fade = 240
    yy = np.arange(target_h, dtype=np.float32)
    a = np.minimum(1.0, np.minimum(yy / fade, (target_h - 1 - yy) / fade))
    a = np.clip(a, 0, 1) ** 1.2
    mask = Image.fromarray((a[:, None] * np.ones((1, target_w), dtype=np.float32) * 255).astype(np.uint8), "L")
    bg.paste(sharp, (0, y0), mask)

    # global vignette
    vig = Image.new("L", (W, H), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(vig).ellipse((-W * 0.12, -H * 0.18, W * 1.12, H * 1.18), fill=255)
    vig = vig.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(220))
    dark = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (10, 4, 3))
    bg = Image.composite(bg, dark, vig)

    bg.save(os.path.join(OUT, "food-expanded-seamless-3200x1800.png"))
    bg.convert("RGB").save(os.path.join(OUT, "food-expanded-seamless-3200x1800.jpg"), "JPEG", quality=94, subsampling=0, optimize=True)
    bg.resize((1920, 1080), Image.LANCZOS).save(os.path.join(OUT, "food-expanded-seamless-1920x1080.png"))
    print("saved", bg.size)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"}

{"file_path": "bingge-bbq\work-food\expand_seamless2.py", "content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Full-width 16:9 extension, global radial grade instead of per-photo rim darkening."""
import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
import expand as E

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "food")
W, H = 3200, 1800


def main():
    im = E.load()
    im = E.grade(im)
    # no per-photo rim darkening: let the global grade handle the falloff
    bg = E.background(im)

    target_h = int(im.height * W / im.width)
    sharp = im.resize((W, target_h), Image.LANCZOS)
    y0 = (H - target_h) // 2

    fade = 240
    yy = np.arange(target_h, dtype=np.float32)
    a = np.minimum(1.0, np.minimum(yy / fade, (target_h - 1 - yy) / fade))
    a = np.clip(a, 0, 1) ** 1.2
    mask = Image.fromarray((a[:, None] * np.ones((1, W), dtype=np.float32) * 255).astype(np.uint8), "L")
    bg.paste(sharp, (0, y0), mask)

    # smooth global radial darkening
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:H, 0:W].astype(np.float32)
    cx, cy = W * 0.50, H * 0.55
    d = np.sqrt(((xx - cx) / (W * 0.62)) ** 2 + ((yy - cy) / (H * 0.62)) ** 2)
    d = np.clip((d - 0.25) / 0.75, 0, 1)
    mult = 1.0 - 0.62 * (d ** 1.15)
    arr = np.asarray(bg).astype(np.float32)
    arr[:, :, :3] *= mult[:, :, None]
    bg = Image.fromarray(np.clip(arr, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8), "RGB")

    bg.save(os.path.join(OUT, "food-expanded-final-3200x1800.png"))
    bg.convert("RGB").save(os.path.join(OUT, "food-expanded-final-3200x1800.jpg"), "JPEG", quality=94, subsampling=0, optimize=True)
    bg.resize((1920, 1080), Image.LANCZOS).save(os.path.join(OUT, "food-expanded-final-1920x1080.png"))
    print("saved", bg.size)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"}

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

{"file_path": "bingge-bbq\work-card\build_card.py", "content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Two-sided 90 × 54 mm review / thank-you card for Bingge BBQ."""
import math
import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "card")
AVATAR = os.path.join(ROOT, "final-assets", "01-avatar", "bingge-avatar-1024.png")
W, H = 2126, 1276

DARK = (46, 26, 18)
DARK2 = (24, 13, 9)
CREAM = (243, 231, 205)
ORANGE = (242, 138, 46)
RED = (192, 57, 43)
INK = (43, 35, 25)
OLIVE = (107, 112, 53)
GOLD = (242, 178, 60)
BRASS = (176, 141, 79)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)

SANS = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\NotoSansSC-VF.ttf"
SANS_B = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\Noto Sans SC Bold (TrueType).otf"
SERIF = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\NotoSerifSC-VF.ttf"
XING = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\STXINGKA.TTF"


def font(path, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)


def ls_text(d, xy, s, f, fill, spacing=0, anchor="la"):
    if not spacing:
        d.text(xy, s, font=f, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)
        return
    x, y = xy
    for ch in s:
        d.text((x, y), ch, font=f, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)
        x += f.getlength(ch) + spacing


def make_bg(w, h, dark=True):
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:h, 0:w].astype(np.float32)
    dx = (xx - w * 0.45) / (w * 0.7)
    dy = (yy - h * 0.45) / (h * 0.7)
    d = np.clip(np.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), 0, 1) ** 1.15
    c1 = np.array(DARK, dtype=np.float32)
    c2 = np.array(DARK2, dtype=np.float32)
    arr = np.zeros((h, w, 4), dtype=np.uint8)
    for i in range(3):
        arr[:, :, i] = (c1[i] * (1 - d) + c2[i] * d).astype(np.uint8)
    arr[:, :, 3] = 255
    im = Image.fromarray(arr, "RGBA")
    # faint diagonal grill lines
    overlay = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay)
    for x in range(-h, w, 54):
        d.line((x, 0, x + h, h), fill=(255, 255, 255, 5), width=2)
    im = Image.alpha_composite(im, overlay)
    # grain
    rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
    noise = rng.normal(0, 2.2, (h, w, 1)).repeat(3, axis=2)
    base = np.asarray(im).astype(np.float32)
    base[:, :, :3] = np.clip(base[:, :, :3] + noise, 0, 255)
    return Image.fromarray(base.astype(np.uint8), "RGBA")


def star(d, cx, cy, r, fill=GOLD, outline=None):
    pts = []
    for i in range(10):
        a = -math.pi / 2 + i * math.pi / 5
        rr = r if i % 2 == 0 else r * 0.42
        pts.append((cx + rr * math.cos(a), cy + rr * math.sin(a)))
    d.polygon(pts, fill=fill, outline=outline)


def logo_tile(board, box, tile_fill=CREAM, radius=22, avatar_pad=10):
    x, y, s = box
    tile = Image.new("RGBA", (s, s), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    td = ImageDraw.Draw(tile)
    td.rounded_rectangle((0, 0, s, s), radius=radius, fill=tile_fill + (255,))
    board.alpha_composite(tile, (x, y))
    av = Image.open(AVATAR).convert("RGBA").resize((s - avatar_pad * 2, s - avatar_pad * 2), Image.LANCZOS)
    mask = Image.new("L", av.size, 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(mask).rounded_rectangle((0, 0, av.width, av.height), radius=max(6, radius - 8), fill=255)
    board.paste(av, (x + avatar_pad, y + avatar_pad), mask)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
    d.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + s, y + s), radius=radius, outline=RED + (255,), width=2)


def qr_placeholder(board, x, y, s):
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
    d.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + s, y + s), radius=10, fill=WHITE, outline=RED, width=3)
    # dashed inner
    step = 18
    for i in range(x + 12, x + s - 12, step * 2):
        d.line((i, y + 12, min(i + step, x + s - 12), y + 12), fill=(200, 200, 200), width=2)
        d.line((i, y + s - 12, min(i + step, x + s - 12), y + s - 12), fill=(200, 200, 200), width=2)
    for i in range(y + 12, y + s - 12, step * 2):
        d.line((x + 12, i, x + 12, min(i + step, y + s - 12)), fill=(200, 200, 200), width=2)
        d.line((x + s - 12, i, x + s - 12, min(i + step, y + s - 12)), fill=(200, 200, 200), width=2)
    f = font(SANS, int(s * 0.095))
    d.text((x + s / 2, y + s / 2 - 8), "二维码位置", font=f, fill=(150, 140, 125), anchor="mm")
    d.text((x + s / 2, y + s / 2 + 24), "QR CODE", font=font(SANS_B, int(s * 0.06)), fill=(190, 180, 165), anchor="mm")


def front():
    bg = make_bg(W, H, True)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(bg)
    # top branding
    logo_tile(bg, (90, 70, 190), CREAM, 22, 10)
    d.text((310, 92), "兵哥烧烤", font=font(XING, 96), fill=WHITE)
    d.text((315, 208), "BINGGE BBQ · 炭火现烤", font=font(SANS_B, 21), fill=CREAM)
    d.text((2030, 96), "外卖好评卡 / REVIEW CARD", font=font(SANS_B, 18), fill=ORANGE, anchor="ra")

    # headline
    d.text((90, 330), "好评返现卡", font=font(SANS_B, 190), fill=ORANGE, stroke_width=9, stroke_fill=CREAM)
    for i in range(5):
        star(d, 120 + i * 62, 650, 26, GOLD)
    d.text((95, 695), "点亮5星好评 · 返2元现金", font=font(SANS_B, 50), fill=CREAM)

    # QR
    qr_placeholder(bg, 95, 830, 250)
    d.text((95, 1105), "扫码添加客服", font=font(SANS_B, 28), fill=CREAM)
    d.text((95, 1148), "13178068912", font=font(SANS_B, 30), fill=GOLD)

    # right rules panel
    d.rounded_rectangle((1240, 300, 2040, 1150), radius=24, fill=CREAM)
    d.text((1290, 345), "参与方式", font=font(SANS_B, 36), fill=INK)

{"file_path": "bingge-bbq\work-card\build_card.py", "content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Two-sided 90 × 54 mm review / thank-you card for Bingge BBQ."""
import math
import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "card")
AVATAR = os.path.join(ROOT, "final-assets", "01-avatar", "bingge-avatar-1024.png")
W, H = 2126, 1276

DARK = (46, 26, 18)
DARK2 = (24, 13, 9)
CREAM = (243, 231, 205)
ORANGE = (242, 138, 46)
RED = (192, 57, 43)
INK = (43, 35, 25)
OLIVE = (107, 112, 53)
GOLD = (242, 178, 60)
BRASS = (176, 141, 79)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)

SANS = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\NotoSansSC-VF.ttf"
SANS_B = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\Noto Sans SC Bold (TrueType).otf"
SERIF = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\NotoSerifSC-VF.ttf"
XING = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\STXINGKA.TTF"


def font(path, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)


def ls_text(d, xy, s, f, fill, spacing=0, anchor="la"):
    if not spacing:
        d.text(xy, s, font=f, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)
        return
    x, y = xy
    for ch in s:
        d.text((x, y), ch, font=f, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)
        x += f.getlength(ch) + spacing


def make_bg(w, h, dark=True):
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:h, 0:w].astype(np.float32)
    dx = (xx - w * 0.45) / (w * 0.7)
    dy = (yy - h * 0.45) / (h * 0.7)
    d = np.clip(np.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), 0, 1) ** 1.15
    c1 = np.array(DARK, dtype=np.float32)
    c2 = np.array(DARK2, dtype=np.float32)
    arr = np.zeros((h, w, 4), dtype=np.uint8)
    for i in range(3):
        arr[:, :, i] = (c1[i] * (1 - d) + c2[i] * d).astype(np.uint8)
    arr[:, :, 3] = 255
    im = Image.fromarray(arr, "RGBA")
    # faint diagonal grill lines
    overlay = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay)
    for x in range(-h, w, 54):
        d.line((x, 0, x + h, h), fill=(255, 255, 255, 5), width=2)
    im = Image.alpha_composite(im, overlay)
    # grain
    rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
    noise = rng.normal(0, 2.2, (h, w, 1)).repeat(3, axis=2)
    base = np.asarray(im).astype(np.float32)
    base[:, :, :3] = np.clip(base[:, :, :3] + noise, 0, 255)
    return Image.fromarray(base.astype(np.uint8), "RGBA")


def star(d, cx, cy, r, fill=GOLD, outline=None):
    pts = []
    for i in range(10):
        a = -math.pi / 2 + i * math.pi / 5
        rr = r if i % 2 == 0 else r * 0.42
        pts.append((cx + rr * math.cos(a), cy + rr * math.sin(a)))
    d.polygon(pts, fill=fill, outline=outline)


def logo_tile(board, box, tile_fill=CREAM, radius=22, avatar_pad=10):
    x, y, s = box
    tile = Image.new("RGBA", (s, s), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    td = ImageDraw.Draw(tile)
    td.rounded_rectangle((0, 0, s, s), radius=radius, fill=tile_fill + (255,))
    board.alpha_composite(tile, (x, y))
    av = Image.open(AVATAR).convert("RGBA").resize((s - avatar_pad * 2, s - avatar_pad * 2), Image.LANCZOS)
    mask = Image.new("L", av.size, 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(mask).rounded_rectangle((0, 0, av.width, av.height), radius=max(6, radius - 8), fill=255)
    board.paste(av, (x + avatar_pad, y + avatar_pad), mask)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
    d.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + s, y + s), radius=radius, outline=RED + (255,), width=2)


def qr_placeholder(board, x, y, s):
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
    d.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + s, y + s), radius=10, fill=WHITE, outline=RED, width=3)
    # dashed inner
    step = 18
    for i in range(x + 12, x + s - 12, step * 2):
        d.line((i, y + 12, min(i + step, x + s - 12), y + 12), fill=(200, 200, 200), width=2)
        d.line((i, y + s - 12, min(i + step, x + s - 12), y + s - 12), fill=(200, 200, 200), width=2)
    for i in range(y + 12, y + s - 12, step * 2):
        d.line((x + 12, i, x + 12, min(i + step, y + s - 12)), fill=(200, 200, 200), width=2)
        d.line((x + s - 12, i, x + s - 12, min(i + step, y + s - 12)), fill=(200, 200, 200), width=2)
    f = font(SANS, int(s * 0.095))
    d.text((x + s / 2, y + s / 2 - 8), "二维码位置", font=f, fill=(150, 140, 125), anchor="mm")
    d.text((x + s / 2, y + s / 2 + 24), "QR CODE", font=font(SANS_B, int(s * 0.06)), fill=(190, 180, 165), anchor="mm")


def front():
    bg = make_bg(W, H, True)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(bg)
    # top branding
    logo_tile(bg, (90, 70, 190), CREAM, 22, 10)
    d.text((310, 92), "兵哥烧烤", font=font(XING, 96), fill=WHITE)
    d.text((315, 208), "BINGGE BBQ · 炭火现烤", font=font(SANS_B, 21), fill=CREAM)
    d.text((2030, 96), "外卖好评卡 / REVIEW CARD", font=font(SANS_B, 18), fill=ORANGE, anchor="ra")

    # headline
    d.text((90, 330), "好评返现卡", font=font(SANS_B, 190), fill=ORANGE, stroke_width=9, stroke_fill=CREAM)
    for i in range(5):
        star(d, 120 + i * 62, 650, 26, GOLD)
    d.text((95, 695), "点亮5星好评 · 返2元现金", font=font(SANS_B, 50), fill=CREAM)

    # QR
    qr_placeholder(bg, 95, 830, 250)
    d.text((95, 1105), "扫码添加客服", font=font(SANS_B, 28), fill=CREAM)
    d.text((95, 1148), "13178068912", font=font(SANS_B, 30), fill=GOLD)

    # right rules panel
    d.rounded_rectangle((1240, 300, 2040, 1150), radius=24, fill=CREAM)
    d.text((1290, 345), "参与方式", font=font(SANS_B, 36), fill=INK)
    d.line((1290, 405, 1990, 405), fill=INK, width=2)
    steps = [
        ("①", "点亮5星好评"),
        ("②", "20字以上好评 + 1张菜品图"),
        ("③", "截图发给客服"),
        ("④", "领取2元现金"),
    ]
    for i, (num, t) in enumerate(steps):
        y = 445 + i * 78
        d.text((1290, y), num, font=font(SANS_B, 30), fill=RED)
        d.text((1340, y), t, font=font(SANS, 26), fill=INK)
    d.line((1290, 790, 1990, 790), fill=INK, width=1)
    d.text((1290, 825), "晒图 + 好评后截图给客服", font=font(SANS_B, 24), fill=RED)
    d.text((1290, 870), "活动最终解释权归本店所有", font=font(SANS, 16), fill=INK)
    d.text((1290, 1070), "本卡仅供本店外卖顾客使用", font=font(SANS, 15), fill=(120, 100, 75))

    # red badge
    d.ellipse((1800, 230, 1970, 400), fill=RED)
    d.text((1885, 315), "返2元", font=font(SANS_B, 34), fill=CREAM, anchor="mm")
    return bg.convert("RGB")


def back():
    bg = make_bg(W, H, True)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(bg)
    # left thank-you half
    d.rectangle((0, 0, 1063, H), fill=CREAM)
    d.text((90, 115), "感谢遇见你", font=font(SERIF, 82), fill=INK)
    ls_text(d, (95, 230), "THANKS TO MEET YOU", font(SANS_B, 22), RED, 4)
    lines = [
        "亲，收到餐品有任何不满意的地方，",
        "请先与我们联系和沟通，",
        "相信我们能做到让您满意为止！",
    ]
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        d.text((95, 330 + i * 50), line, font=font(SANS, 28), fill=INK)
    d.line((95, 545, 950, 545), fill=BRASS, width=2)
    d.text((95, 585), "售后专线", font=font(SANS_B, 18), fill=BRASS)
    d.text((95, 620), "13178068912", font=font(SANS_B, 40), fill=INK)
    d.text((95, 700), "我们珍惜每一次相遇", font=font(SANS, 20), fill=(110, 85, 55))

    # small brand mark bottom-left
    logo_tile(bg, (90, 930, 120), CREAM, 18, 8)
    d.text((230, 950), "兵哥烧烤", font=font(XING, 54), fill=INK)
    d.text((232, 1015), "BINGGE BBQ · FIELD GRILL", font=font(SANS_B, 14), fill=BRASS)
    d.text((95, 1120), "本卡仅供本店外卖顾客使用", font=font(SANS, 15), fill=(120, 100, 75))

    # divider
    d.line((1063, 60, 1063, H - 60), fill=BRASS, width=2)

    # right review half
    d.text((1120, 105), "好评返现", font=font(SANS_B, 100), fill=ORANGE)
    d.text((1125, 235), "5星好评 · 返2元现金", font=font(SANS_B, 30), fill=CREAM)
    review = [
        "全5星 + 20字以上好评",
        "+ 1张菜品图 + 晒图",
        "截图发给客服，领取2元现金",
    ]
    for i, line in enumerate(review):
        d.text((1125, 320 + i * 46), line, font=font(SANS, 26), fill=CREAM)
    d.text((1125, 500), "客服电话 13178068912", font=font(SANS_B, 22), fill=GOLD)

    qr_placeholder(bg, 1700, 540, 250)
    d.text((1700, 805), "扫码领现金", font=font(SANS_B, 22), fill=CREAM)

    # warning box
    d.rounded_rectangle((1120, 870, 1990, 945), radius=16, fill=CREAM)
    d.text((1150, 892), "截图时请勿拍下此卡片哦", font=font(SANS_B, 26), fill=RED)
    d.text((1125, 975), "晒图时把菜品拍好看一点，通过率更高", font=font(SANS, 17), fill=CREAM)
    d.text((1125, 1130), "活动最终解释权归本店所有", font=font(SANS, 14), fill=(210, 190, 160))
    return bg.convert("RGB")


def preview(front_im, back_im):
    Wp, Hp = 2400, 1500
    board = Image.new("RGB", (Wp, Hp), (239, 229, 210))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
    d.text((100, 80), "兵哥烧烤 · 好评返现卡", font=font(SERIF, 62), fill=INK)
    d.text((100, 165), "90 × 54 mm · 双面横版 · 300 dpi", font=font(SANS, 20), fill=(120, 95, 55))
    d.line((100, 210, 2300, 210), fill=INK, width=2)
    fw, fh = 1000, 600
    for i, (im, label) in enumerate([(front_im, "正面 / FRONT"), (back_im, "背面 / BACK")]):
        x = 150 + i * 1100
        y = 330
        card = im.resize((fw, fh), Image.LANCZOS).convert("RGBA")
        sh = Image.new("RGBA", (fw + 40, fh + 40), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        mask = Image.new("L", (fw, fh), 0)
        ImageDraw.Draw(mask).rounded_rectangle((0, 0, fw, fh), radius=16, fill=255)
        sh.paste((0, 0, 0, 90), (20, 28), mask.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(18)))
        board.paste(sh, (x - 20, y - 20), sh)
        board.paste(card, (x, y), mask)
        d.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + fw, y + fh), radius=16, outline=INK, width=2)
        d.text((x, y + fh + 25), label, font=font(SANS_B, 24), fill=INK)
    board.save(os.path.join(OUT, "card-preview.png"))
    print("preview saved")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    f = front()
    b = back()
    f.save(os.path.join(OUT, "card-front-600dpi.png"))

    b.resize((1063, 638), Image.LANCZOS).convert("RGB").save(os.path.join(OUT, "card-back-300dpi.jpg"), "JPEG", quality=95, subsampling=0, optimize=True)
    f.resize((1063, 638), Image.LANCZOS).save(os.path.join(OUT, "card-front-back-300dpi.pdf"), save_all=True, append_images=[b.resize((1063, 638), Image.LANCZOS)], resolution=300.0)

OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "card")
AVATAR = os.path.join(ROOT, "final-assets", "01-avatar", "bingge-avatar-1024.png")
W, H = 2126, 1276

DARK = (46, 26, 18)
DARK2 = (24, 13, 9)
CREAM = (243, 231, 205)
ORANGE = (242, 138, 46)
RED = (192, 57, 43)
INK = (43, 35, 25)
OLIVE = (107, 112, 53)
GOLD = (242, 178, 60)
BRASS = (176, 141, 79)

SANS_B = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\Noto Sans SC Bold (TrueType).otf"
SERIF = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\NotoSerifSC-VF.ttf"
XING = r"C:\Windows\Fonts\STXINGKA.TTF"


def font(path, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)


def ls_text(d, xy, s, f, fill, spacing=0, anchor="la"):
    if not spacing:
        d.text(xy, s, font=f, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)
        return
    x, y = xy
    for ch in s:
        d.text((x, y), ch, font=f, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)
        x += f.getlength(ch) + spacing


def make_bg(w, h, dark=True):
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:h, 0:w].astype(np.float32)
    dx = (xx - w * 0.45) / (w * 0.7)
    dy = (yy - h * 0.45) / (h * 0.7)
    d = np.clip(np.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), 0, 1) ** 1.15
    c1 = np.array(DARK, dtype=np.float32)
    c2 = np.array(DARK2, dtype=np.float32)
    arr = np.zeros((h, w, 4), dtype=np.uint8)
    for i in range(3):
        arr[:, :, i] = (c1[i] * (1 - d) + c2[i] * d).astype(np.uint8)
    arr[:, :, 3] = 255
    im = Image.fromarray(arr, "RGBA")
    # faint diagonal grill lines
    overlay = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay)
    for x in range(-h, w, 54):
        d.line((x, 0, x + h, h), fill=(255, 255, 255, 5), width=2)
    im = Image.alpha_composite(im, overlay)
    # grain
    rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
    noise = rng.normal(0, 2.2, (h, w, 1)).repeat(3, axis=2)
    base = np.asarray(im).astype(np.float32)
    base[:, :, :3] = np.clip(base[:, :, :3] + noise, 0, 255)
    return Image.fromarray(base.astype(np.uint8), "RGBA")


def star(d, cx, cy, r, fill=GOLD, outline=None):
    pts = []
    for i in range(10):
        a = -math.pi / 2 + i * math.pi / 5
        rr = r if i % 2 == 0 else r * 0.42
        pts.append((cx + rr * math.cos(a), cy + rr * math.sin(a)))
    d.polygon(pts, fill=fill, outline=outline)


def logo_tile(board, box, tile_fill=CREAM, radius=22, avatar_pad=10):
    x, y, s = box
    tile = Image.new("RGBA", (s, s), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    td = ImageDraw.Draw(tile)
    td.rounded_rectangle((0, 0, s, s), radius=radius, fill=tile_fill + (255,))
    board.alpha_composite(tile, (x, y))
    av = Image.open(AVATAR).convert("RGBA").resize((s - avatar_pad * 2, s - avatar_pad * 2), Image.LANCZOS)
    mask = Image.new("L", av.size, 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(mask).rounded_rectangle((0, 0, av.width, av.height), radius=max(6, radius - 8), fill=255)
    board.paste(av, (x + avatar_pad, y + avatar_pad), mask)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
    d.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + s, y + s), radius=radius, outline=RED + (255,), width=2)


def qr_placeholder(board, x, y, s):
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
    d.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + s, y + s), radius=10, fill=WHITE, outline=RED, width=3)
    # dashed inner
    step = 18
    for i in range(x + 12, x + s - 12, step * 2):
        d.line((i, y + 12, min(i + step, x + s - 12), y + 12), fill=(200, 200, 200), width=2)
        d.line((i, y + s - 12, min(i + step, x + s - 12), y + s - 12), fill=(200, 200, 200), width=2)
    for i in range(y + 12, y + s - 12, step * 2):
        d.line((x + 12, i, x + 12, min(i + step, y + s - 12)), fill=(200, 200, 200), width=2)
        d.line((x + s - 12, i, x + s - 12, min(i + step, y + s - 12)), fill=(200, 200, 200), width=2)
    f = font(SANS, int(s * 0.095))
    d.text((x + s / 2, y + s / 2 - 8), "二维码位置", font=f, fill=(150, 140, 125), anchor="mm")
    d.text((x + s / 2, y + s / 2 + 24), "QR CODE", font=font(SANS_B, int(s * 0.06)), fill=(190, 180, 165), anchor="mm")


def front():
    bg = make_bg(W, H, True)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(bg)
    # top branding
    logo_tile(bg, (90, 70, 190), CREAM, 22, 10)
    d.text((310, 92), "兵哥烧烤", font=font(XING, 96), fill=WHITE)
    d.text((315, 208), "BINGGE BBQ · 炭火现烤", font=font(SANS_B, 21), fill=CREAM)
    d.text((2030, 96), "外卖好评卡 / REVIEW CARD", font=font(SANS_B, 18), fill=ORANGE, anchor="ra")

    # headline
    d.text((90, 330), "好评返现卡", font=font(SANS_B, 190), fill=ORANGE, stroke_width=9, stroke_fill=CREAM)
    for i in range(5):
        star(d, 120 + i * 62, 650, 26, GOLD)
    d.text((95, 695), "点亮5星好评 · 返2元现金", font=font(SANS_B, 50), fill=CREAM)

    # QR
    qr_placeholder(bg, 95, 830, 250)
    d.text((95, 1105), "扫码添加客服", font=font(SANS_B, 28), fill=CREAM)
    d.text((95, 1148), "13178068912", font=font(SANS_B, 30), fill=GOLD)

    # right rules panel
    d.rounded_rectangle((1240, 300, 2040, 1150), radius=24, fill=CREAM)
    d.text((1290, 345), "参与方式", font=font(SANS_B, 36), fill=INK)
    d.line((1290, 405, 1990, 405), fill=INK, width=2)
    steps = [
        ("①", "点亮5星好评"),
        ("②", "20字以上好评 + 1张菜品图"),
        ("③", "截图发给客服"),
        ("④", "领取2元现金"),
    ]
    for i, (num, t) in enumerate(steps):
        y = 445 + i * 78
        d.text((1290, y), num, font=font(SANS_B, 30), fill=RED)
        d.text((1340, y), t, font=font(SANS, 26), fill=INK)
    d.line((1290, 790, 1990, 790), fill=INK, width=1)
    d.text((1290, 825), "晒图 + 好评后截图给客服", font=font(SANS_B, 24), fill=RED)
    d.text((1290, 870), "活动最终解释权归本店所有", font=font(SANS, 16), fill=INK)
    d.text((1290, 1070), "本卡仅供本店外卖顾客使用", font=font(SANS, 15), fill=(120, 100, 75))

    # red badge
    d.ellipse((1800, 230, 1970, 400), fill=RED)
    d.text((1885, 315), "返2元", font=font(SANS_B, 34), fill=CREAM, anchor="mm")
    return bg.convert("RGB")


def back():
    bg = make_bg(W, H, True)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(bg)
    # left thank-you half
    d.rectangle((0, 0, 1063, H), fill=CREAM)
    d.text((90, 115), "感谢遇见你", font=font(SERIF, 82), fill=INK)
    ls_text(d, (95, 230), "THANKS TO MEET YOU", font(SANS_B, 22), RED, 4)
    lines = [
        "亲，收到餐品有任何不满意的地方，",
        "请先与我们联系和沟通，",
        "相信我们能做到让您满意为止！",
    ]
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        d.text((95, 330 + i * 50), line, font=font(SANS, 28), fill=INK)
    d.line((95, 545, 950, 545), fill=BRASS, width=2)
    d.text((95, 585), "售后专线", font=font(SANS_B, 18), fill=BRASS)
    d.text((95, 620), "13178068912", font=font(SANS_B, 40), fill=INK)
    d.text((95, 700), "我们珍惜每一次相遇", font=font(SANS, 20), fill=(110, 85, 55))

    # small brand mark bottom-left
    logo_tile(bg, (90, 930, 120), CREAM, 18, 8)
    d.text((230, 950), "兵哥烧烤", font=font(XING, 54), fill=INK)
    d.text((232, 1015), "BINGGE BBQ · FIELD GRILL", font=font(SANS_B, 14), fill=BRASS)
    d.text((95, 1120), "本卡仅供本店外卖顾客使用", font=font(SANS, 15), fill=(120, 100, 75))

    # divider
    d.line((1063, 60, 1063, H - 60), fill=BRASS, width=2)

    # right review half
    d.text((1120, 105), "好评返现", font=font(SANS_B, 100), fill=ORANGE)
    d.text((1125, 235), "5星好评 · 返2元现金", font=font(SANS_B, 30), fill=CREAM)
    review = [
        "全5星 + 20字以上好评",
        "+ 1张菜品图 + 晒图",
        "截图发给客服，领取2元现金",
    ]
    for i, line in enumerate(review):
        d.text((1125, 320 + i * 46), line, font=font(SANS, 26), fill=CREAM)
    d.text((1125, 500), "客服电话 13178068912", font=font(SANS_B, 22), fill=GOLD)

    qr_placeholder(bg, 1700, 540, 250)
    d.text((1700, 805), "扫码领现金", font=font(SANS_B, 22), fill=CREAM)

    # warning box
    d.rounded_rectangle((1120, 870, 1990, 945), radius=16, fill=CREAM)
    d.text((1150, 892), "截图时请勿拍下此卡片哦", font=font(SANS_B, 26), fill=RED)
    d.text((1125, 975), "晒图时把菜品拍好看一点，通过率更高", font=font(SANS, 17), fill=CREAM)
    d.text((1125, 1130), "活动最终解释权归本店所有", font=font(SANS, 14), fill=(210, 190, 160))
    return bg.convert("RGB")


def preview(front_im, back_im):
    Wp, Hp = 2400, 1500
    board = Image.new("RGB", (Wp, Hp), (239, 229, 210))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
    d.text((100, 80), "兵哥烧烤 · 好评返现卡", font=font(SERIF, 62), fill=INK)
    d.text((100, 165), "90 × 54 mm · 双面横版 · 300 dpi", font=font(SANS, 20), fill=(120, 95, 55))
    d.line((100, 210, 2300, 210), fill=INK, width=2)
    fw, fh = 1000, 600
    for i, (im, label) in enumerate([(front_im, "正面 / FRONT"), (back_im, "背面 / BACK")]):
        x = 150 + i * 1100
        y = 330
        card = im.resize((fw, fh), Image.LANCZOS).convert("RGBA")
        sh = Image.new("RGBA", (fw + 40, fh + 40), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        mask = Image.new("L", (fw, fh), 0)
        ImageDraw.Draw(mask).rounded_rectangle((0, 0, fw, fh), radius=16, fill=255)
        sh.paste((0, 0, 0, 90), (20, 28), mask.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(18)))
        board.paste(sh, (x - 20, y - 20), sh)
        board.paste(card, (x, y), mask)
        d.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + fw, y + fh), radius=16, outline=INK, width=2)
        d.text((x, y + fh + 25), label, font=font(SANS_B, 24), fill=INK)
    board.save(os.path.join(OUT, "card-preview.png"))
    print("preview saved")

    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

    preview(f, b)
    print("saved", OUT)

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

{"file_path": "bingge-bbq\work-card\build_front_gold.py", "content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Black-gold front for the Bingge BBQ review card."""
import math
import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import build_card as C

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "card")
W, H = C.W, C.H

BLACK = (10, 10, 8)
BLACK2 = (26, 24, 18)
GOLD = (206, 170, 72)
GOLD_LIGHT = (244, 216, 137)
GOLD_DARK = (139, 103, 35)
CREAM = C.CREAM
RED = C.RED
INK = C.INK
SANS = C.SANS
SANS_B = C.SANS_B
XING = C.XING
SERIF = C.SERIF


def black_bg():
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:H, 0:W].astype(np.float32)
    dx = (xx - W * 0.55) / (W * 0.75)
    dy = (yy - H * 0.45) / (H * 0.75)
    d = np.clip(np.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), 0, 1) ** 1.2
    c1 = np.array((26, 24, 18), dtype=np.float32)
    c2 = np.array((6, 6, 5), dtype=np.float32)
    arr = np.zeros((H, W, 4), dtype=np.uint8)
    for i in range(3):
        arr[:, :, i] = (c1[i] * (1 - d) + c2[i] * d).astype(np.uint8)
    arr[:, :, 3] = 255
    im = Image.fromarray(arr, "RGBA")
    # leather-like diagonal texture
    tex = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(tex)
    for x in range(-H, W, 22):
        d.line((x, 0, x + H, H), fill=(255, 235, 180, 5), width=1)
    for x in range(-H, W, 66):
        d.line((x, 0, x + H, H), fill=(0, 0, 0, 40), width=2)
    im = Image.alpha_composite(im, tex)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(12)
    noise = rng.normal(0, 2.6, (H, W, 1)).repeat(3, axis=2)
    base = np.asarray(im).astype(np.float32)
    base[:, :, :3] = np.clip(base[:, :, :3] + noise, 0, 255)
    return Image.fromarray(base.astype(np.uint8), "RGBA")


def gold_gradient(w, h):
    arr = np.zeros((h, w, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
    for y in range(h):
        t = y / max(1, h - 1)
        if t < 0.5:
            k = t / 0.5
            col = tuple(int(GOLD_LIGHT[i] * (1 - k) + GOLD[i] * k) for i in range(3))
        else:
            k = (t - 0.5) / 0.5
            col = tuple(int(GOLD[i] * (1 - k) + GOLD_DARK[i] * k) for i in range(3))
        arr[y, :, :] = col
    rng = np.random.default_rng(3)
    noise = rng.normal(0, 5, (h, w, 1)).repeat(3, axis=2)
    arr = np.clip(arr.astype(np.float32) + noise, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
    return Image.fromarray(arr, "RGB")


def gold_text(board, xy, s, f, stroke=2):
    mask = Image.new("L", board.size, 0)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
    d.text(xy, s, font=f, fill=255, stroke_width=stroke, stroke_fill=255)
    grad = gold_gradient(*board.size)
    board.paste(grad, (0, 0), mask)


def ornament_border(d):
    d.rectangle((36, 36, W - 36, H - 36), outline=GOLD, width=3)
    d.rectangle((52, 52, W - 52, H - 52), outline=GOLD_DARK, width=1)
    # corner ornaments
    for x, y, sx, sy in [(36, 36, 1, 1), (W - 36, 36, -1, 1), (36, H - 36, 1, -1), (W - 36, H - 36, -1, -1)]:
        d.line((x, y + sy * 70, x, y, x + sx * 70, y), fill=GOLD, width=4)
        d.line((x + sx * 18, y + sy * 18, x + sx * 52, y + sy * 18), fill=GOLD_DARK, width=1)
        d.line((x + sx * 18, y + sy * 18, x + sx * 18, y + sy * 52), fill=GOLD_DARK, width=1)
        d.rectangle((x + sx * 10 - 4, y + sy * 10 - 4, x + sx * 10 + 4, y + sy * 10 + 4), fill=GOLD)


def guilloche(board):
    layer = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
    cx, cy = 1780, 780
    for r in range(260, 780, 46):
        d.ellipse((cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r), outline=GOLD + (26,), width=1)
    for i in range(24):
        a = 2 * math.pi * i / 24
        d.line((cx, cy, cx + 820 * math.cos(a), cy + 820 * math.sin(a)), fill=GOLD + (18,), width=1)
    board.alpha_composite(layer)


def medallion(board):
    layer = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
    cx, cy, r = 300, 930, 145
    for rr, w in [(r, 2), (r - 12, 1), (r - 28, 1)]:
        d.ellipse((cx - rr, cy - rr, cx + rr, cy + rr), outline=GOLD + (120,), width=w)
    C.star(d, cx, cy, 55, GOLD + (160,), GOLD_LIGHT + (220,))
    d.text((cx, cy + 94), "5 STAR", font=C.font(SANS_B, 18), fill=GOLD + (210,), anchor="mm")
    d.text((cx, cy + 122), "五星好评 · 专享返现", font=C.font(SANS, 13), fill=CREAM + (170,), anchor="mm")
    board.alpha_composite(layer)


def panel(board):
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
    d.rounded_rectangle((1240, 300, 2040, 1120), radius=22, fill=(9, 9, 7, 255), outline=GOLD, width=2)
    d.rounded_rectangle((1252, 312, 2028, 1108), radius=18, outline=GOLD_DARK, width=1)
    d.text((1290, 350), "参与方式", font=C.font(SANS_B, 42), fill=GOLD_LIGHT)
    d.line((1290, 415, 1990, 415), fill=GOLD, width=2)
    steps = [
        ("1", "点亮5星好评"),
        ("2", "20字以上好评 + 1张菜品图"),
        ("3", "截图发给客服"),
        ("4", "领取2元现金"),
    ]
    for i, (num, t) in enumerate(steps):
        y = 470 + i * 96
        d.ellipse((1290, y - 2, 1334, y + 42), outline=GOLD, width=2)
        d.text((1312, y + 20), num, font=C.font(SANS_B, 22), fill=GOLD_LIGHT, anchor="mm")
        d.text((1352, y), t, font=C.font(SANS, 30), fill=CREAM)
    d.line((1290, 900, 1990, 900), fill=GOLD_DARK, width=1)
    d.text((1290, 930), "截图给客服，领取2元现金", font=C.font(SANS_B, 27), fill=GOLD_LIGHT)
    d.text((1290, 1040), "活动最终解释权归本店所有", font=C.font(SANS, 15), fill=(195, 170, 120))


def front_gold():
    bg = black_bg()
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(bg)
    ornament_border(d)
    guilloche(bg)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(bg)
    medallion(bg)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(bg)

    # logo
    C.logo_tile(bg, (90, 80, 180), (18, 18, 14), 22, 10)
    d.text((300, 96), "兵哥烧烤", font=C.font(XING, 94), fill=CREAM)
    d.text((304, 206), "BINGGE BBQ · BLACK CARD", font=C.font(SANS_B, 18), fill=GOLD_LIGHT)
    d.text((2030, 96), "五星好评 · 专享返现", font=C.font(SANS_B, 18), fill=GOLD, anchor="ra")

    # headline
    gold_text(bg, (90, 300), "好评返现卡", C.font(SANS_B, 192), 2)
    for i in range(5):
        C.star(d, 120 + i * 62, 600, 26, GOLD, GOLD_LIGHT)
    d.text((95, 642), "点亮5星好评 · 返2元现金", font=C.font(SANS_B, 46), fill=CREAM)
    d.text((95, 715), "REVIEW & CASHBACK", font=C.font(SANS_B, 18), fill=GOLD, spacing=4)

    # gold seal
    d.ellipse((1800, 230, 1970, 400), fill=GOLD, outline=GOLD_LIGHT, width=3)
    d.ellipse((1812, 242, 1958, 388), outline=GOLD_DARK, width=2)
    d.text((1885, 305), "返2元", font=C.font(SANS_B, 32), fill=INK, anchor="mm")
    d.text((1885, 345), "CASH", font=C.font(SANS_B, 14), fill=INK, anchor="mm")

    panel(bg)
    d.text((95, 1160), "本卡仅供本店外卖顾客使用", font=C.font(SANS, 14), fill=(190, 165, 115))
    return bg.convert("RGB")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    f = front_gold()
    f.save(os.path.join(OUT, "card-front-600dpi.png"))
    f.resize((1063, 638), Image.LANCZOS).save(os.path.join(OUT, "card-front-300dpi.png"))
    f.resize((1063, 638), Image.LANCZOS).convert("RGB").save(os.path.join(OUT, "card-front-300dpi.jpg"), "JPEG", quality=95, subsampling=0, optimize=True)
    f.convert("RGB").save(os.path.join(OUT, "card-front-600dpi.jpg"), "JPEG", quality=95, subsampling=0, optimize=True)
    b = Image.open(os.path.join(OUT, "card-back-600dpi.png")).convert("RGB")
    f.resize((1063, 638), Image.LANCZOS).save(os.path.join(OUT, "card-front-back-300dpi.pdf"), save_all=True, append_images=[b.resize((1063, 638), Image.LANCZOS)], resolution=300.0)
    C.preview(f, b)
    print("gold front saved")
"}
